📘New words — كل كلمات الوحدةالكلمات الجديدة

اضغط 🔊 لتسمع نطق الكلمة بصوت بشرى طبيعى.
familyأسرة / عائلة
your father, mother, brothers and sisters
fatherأب
your dad — the man in your family
motherأم
your mum — the woman in your family
grandfatherجد
the father of your father or mother
grandmotherجدة
the mother of your father or mother
brotherأخ
a boy with the same father and mother as you
sisterأخت
a girl with the same father and mother as you
photoصورة فوتوغرافية
a picture you take with a camera
littleصغير
small, not big

صفحة 11Reading Comprehensionقطعة القراءة

صورة أسرة Ann

كلام Ann عن أسرتها

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

This is a photo of my family. This is my father. His name is Edward. My mother is Susan. She is wearing a pink t-shirt. My grandfather is standing next to my father. My grandmother is standing next to my mother. This is Sue. She is my little sister. John, my little brother, is standing next to Sue. I love my family.

صفحة 15Writingالكتابة

1 — Punctuate the following sentences.

9 this is my father
This is my father.
10 his name is Edward
His name is Edward.
11 this is my little brother
This is my little brother.
12 my little sister is eight years old
My little sister is eight years old.
Important Note — الأسماء العَلَم مثل (John and Mary) تُكتب دائمًا بحرف كبير.
